entities.name: Anna Akhmatova Museum at the Fountain House
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Anna Akhmatova Literary and Memorial Museum is a literary museum in St Petersburg, Russia, dedicated to the poet Anna Akhmatova (1889–1966). It opened in 1989 on the centennial of Akhmatova's birth.
